    # Extract the comment editor state from the latest state

        "get new comment editor (WYSIWYG) state", schema=CommentEditor
    )

    # Assert the WYSIWYG comment editor is visible
    assert editor.is_visible, "WYSIWYG comment editor should be visible after clicking 'Add Comment'."
    # Assert there is a placeholder (optional, but helpful for user guidance)
    assert editor.placeholder is not None and len(editor.placeholder.strip()) > 0, "Comment editor should display a placeholder."
    # Assert there are formatting buttons (WYSIWYG)
    assert len(editor.toolbar_buttons) > 0, "WYSIWYG editor toolbar should be present with formatting options."

assertion: The current comments tree is equal to the initially observed comments tree with the addition of exactly one new comment, and no other structural or content changes
code:
```python
def postcondition(session: Session):
    from pydantic import BaseModel, Field
    from typing import List, Optional

    # Define a schema for a comment (with possible replies)
    class Comment(BaseModel):
        id: int = Field(..., description="Unique identifier for the comment")
        author: str = Field(..., description="Author of the comment")
        content: str = Field(..., description="Text content of the comment")
        replies: Optional[List["Comment"]] = Field(default_factory=list, description="List of replies to this comment")

    Comment.update_forward_refs()

    class CommentsTree(BaseModel):
        comments: List[Comment] = Field(default_factory=list, description="Top-level comments (with nested replies)")

    # Extract the initial and current comments tree
    initial_comments = session.history[2].extract("get all comments as tree", schema=CommentsTree).comments
    current_comments = session.history[-1].extract("get all comments as tree", schema=CommentsTree).comments

    # Flatten comments tree to a list of (id, author, content) for comparison
    def flatten_comments(comments):
        flat = []
        for c in comments:
            flat.append((c.id, c.author, c.content))
            if c.replies:
                flat.extend(flatten_comments(c.replies))
        return flat

    initial_flat = flatten_comments(initial_comments)
    current_flat = flatten_comments(current_comments)

    # The new comment content
    new_comment_content = "I like this template"

    # Find the difference between current and initial
    initial_set = set(initial_flat)
    current_set = set(current_flat)
    added = list(current_set - initial_set)

    # There must be exactly one new comment
    assert len(added) == 1, f"Expected exactly one new comment, but found {len(added)} new comments."

    # The new comment must have the expected content
    _, _, added_content = added[0]
    assert added_content == new_comment_content, f"New comment content mismatch: expected '{new_comment_content}', got '{added_content}'."

    # The rest of the comments tree structure and content must be unchanged
    # Remove the new comment from current_flat and compare to initial_flat
    current_flat_minus_new = [c for c in current_flat if c != added[0]]
    assert current_flat_minus_new == initial_flat, "Other comments have changed unexpectedly after adding a new comment."
```
